summary: Iteration 2 frontend-only re-verification of the 3 fixes from iteration_1 plus regression smoke. All 3 HIGH/medium bugs from iteration_1 are CONFIRMED FIXED. Regression smoke (FloatingWhatsApp, PDF modal, /admin/settings, language switch PT/FR/DE) all pass. 10/10 checks green.

verified_fixes.fix: Header LinkedIn is a real anchor
verified_fixes.evidence: header a[data-testid='header-linkedin'] found inside <header> with href=https://www.linkedin.com/company/masterpiece-innovations-b-v/ and target='_blank'. Also header-linkedin-top exists in top contact bar with same href.
/request-quote -> /request-a-quote (200, header rendered); /quote -> /request-a-quote; /rfq -> /request-a-quote; /this-does-not-exist-xyz -> / (Navigate replace, no blank page).

verified_fixes.fix: NL hero h1 hyphenates/wraps without clipping image
verified_fixes.evidence: h1 has classes 'text-[42px] sm:text-[58px] lg:text-[80px] xl:text-[88px] hyphens-auto break-words'. With lang=nl at 1920x1080, h1 'Luchtvaartkwaliteit' wraps to two lines within left column and h1 right edge does not overlap hero image left edge (geometric assertion + screenshot confirmed).

regression_smoke.flow: PDF modal opens from product page
Language switch PT/FR/DE no header overlap
regression_smoke.note: Header height < 200px in all three languages, no wrap/overflow

critical_code_review_comments: Header.jsx: both header-linkedin (in <header>) and header-linkedin-top (in top contact bar) correctly use rel='noopener noreferrer' and target='_blank' — good a11y/security hygiene.
App.js: catch-all '*' to / uses Navigate replace — correct; prevents history pollution. Three explicit legacy aliases (/request-quote, /quote, /rfq) all wired to /request-a-quote.

Hero.jsx: hyphens-auto requires the page's lang attribute to be set on <html> (or parent) for browsers to apply locale-specific hyphenation dictionaries. At 1920w NL it still wraps via break-words even without lang attribute; consider setting <html lang={currentLang.code}> in a future polish for proper soft-hyphen placement (currently it character-breaks 'Luchtvaartkwaliteit' between 't' and 't' producing 'Luchtvaartkwalitei' / 't' on two lines — readable but not ideal Dutch hyphenation). Not a blocker.
test_credentials: Admin via localStorage 'mpt_admin_session' bypass — confirmed working.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend Phase 1 polish is now fully verified and clean. Iteration_1's two HIGH bugs (header LinkedIn anchor, /request-quote blank) and one design issue (NL hero clip) are all fixed and re-verified. App.js now has explicit redirects /request-quote, /quote, /rfq -> /request-a-quote plus catch-all '*' -> /. Header.jsx has two LinkedIn entry points (data-testid='header-linkedin' for the icon button visible md+ and data-testid='header-linkedin-top' for the top contact bar). Hero.jsx h1 uses hyphens-auto break-words. Safe to proceed with backend phase. No regressions observed in WhatsApp, PDF modal, admin Settings CMS, or multi-language nav.
rca of the issue: N/A — all three issues from iteration_1 have been correctly fixed by E1.
